newsitem.title: ITALY: IRI to see 96 2.9 trln lire loss-sources.
newsitem.headline: IRI to see 96 2.9 trln lire loss-sources.

text.p: Italy's giant state industrial holding group IRI sees its 1996 loss at 2.9 trillion lire, according to board sources speaking after a company board meeting on Wednesday.
Previous forecasts for losses at Istituo per la Ricostruzione Industriale (IRI) had been between 2.5 trillion and 3.0 trillion lire.
The board sources said IRI's 1996 results would not gain from the privatisation of the state-controlled telecoms holding group STET, which is now due for privatisation in early 1997.
